q: The Parry measure on an irreducible SFT corresponds to which information-theoretic concept?
opts: The capacity-achieving input distribution (measure of maximal entropy)
The noise distribution of the channel
The empirical distribution of a long typical sequence
exp: The Parry measure is the measure of maximal entropy — it achieves h_μ = h_top. In channel coding terms, it is the input distribution that achieves capacity. This is the variational principle in symbolic dynamics.
